# Application inventory — 143 catalogue entries (2026-11-07)

**Source of truth:** `src/apps/catalogue.ts` (generated by
`scripts/generate-app-catalogue.mjs`), `apps/` (143 directories),
`components/apps/` (44 files).

## How the counts reconcile

| Object | Count | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/` directories | 143 | Every directory under `apps/`, one catalogue entry each |
| Catalogue entries | 143 | Includes absorbed products + engines, not only slices |
| `@aetherius/*` slices | 135 | The `135/135` passing subset (`npm run test:apps`) |
| Non-slice entries | 8 | Absorbed products/engines that are not `@aetherius/*` slices (e.g. LedgerLands, Poietek, IDE-Workspace) |
| `components/apps/` files | 44 | Shell UI components |
| Window-wired (after this milestone) | 30 new + 12 existing = **42 app windows** + Settings | See below |
| Non-window | 2 | `GenesisAvatar.tsx` (renderer), `AppContainer.tsx` (wrapper) |

The 143-vs-135 gap is **different objects**, not an error.

## Shell integration decision (Phase 3)

Every `components/apps/*.tsx` received an explicit integration decision. None was given a
dummy window to inflate the count; components designed as embedded or background services
are labelled as such and open only where they render honestly.

### Wired as standalone windows (42)

Existing 12: Genesis Human, Notes, Writer, Sheets, Slides, Canvas, Recorder, Terminal,
Calculator, Notepad, Browser, Files.

Newly wired via `src/apps/shellRegistry.tsx` (30), each lazy-loaded behind the shell error

### Not windows (2, deliberately)

| Component | Decision |
|---|---|
| `GenesisAvatar.tsx` | **Embedded renderer** — used by Genesis Human; not a window. |
| `AppContainer.tsx` | **Wrapper** — used by legacy apps; not a window. |

### Honesty corrections applied

- **TaskManager:** removed `initialProcesses` with `Math.random()` CPU/memory/network jitter.
  The view now reads `navigator.hardwareConcurrency`, `performance.memory` (Chromium only),
  `navigator.onLine` and the Battery API, and states that per-process telemetry and End Task
  are unavailable in the browser preview.
- No dummy windows: every wired window renders a real `components/apps` component.
  The legacy adapter supplies only `context`/`onSetView` plumbing; it never fakes data,
  permissions or privileged operations.

## Per-entry audit status

Each of the 143 catalogue entries carries the status its own manifest declares
(see Settings → Applications). This milestone's shell integration changes the
*window* state of the 30 components above from UNWIRED to SHELL_INTEGRATED; slice test
status (`TESTED` / `PARTIAL` / `VERIFIED`) is unchanged and still comes from the manifest.
Full per-entry functional verification (input validation, persistence, offline, cloud)
continues as Phase 4 work; no placeholder is claimed as complete.

## Verification

- `npm run typecheck` — clean.
- `npm run test:apps` — **135/135 slices passed**.
- `npm run build` — green; new per-app lazy chunks (e.g. `FinanceApp-*.js`,
  `SocialApp-*.js`), initial `index-*.js` 486 KB.
- All 30 new menu/desktop entries share the registry's component ids, so menu launch,
  desktop icon and launcher resolve to the same window.
